name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Neutron Emitter NE-1 'Clean Sweep'
description: A directed neutron radiation weapon that kills biological organisms while leaving structures, equipment, and electronics completely intact. The NE-1 projects a focused beam of fast neutrons that pass through walls and cover, irradiating everything biological within the beam path with a lethal dose of radiation. Death from neutron exposure is not immediate — targets may survive for hours or days depending on dose, experiencing progressive organ failure as their cells die from radiation damage. The weapon's strategic value lies in its ability to kill the occupants of a building without damaging the building itself — perfect for seizing infrastructure, reclaiming facilities, or silently depopulating areas for reoccupation.
legality: Strategic weapon — Zheng-Dao sovereign authorization only
specifications:
beam type: Focused fast neutron emission
penetration: Passes through standard construction materials
lethal dose delivery: 10 seconds of exposure at 50 meters
effective range: 10-200 meters
weight: 85 kg on vehicle mount
power source: Onboard nuclear source + accelerator
crew: 3 operators with radiation shielding
death timeline: Hours to days depending on exposure duration
countermeasure: Borated polyethylene shielding, 10 cm minimum
story_hooks: An entire apartment building's residents died over 72 hours from what was officially called a chemical leak — but a radiation specialist has found neutron activation signatures in the building's steel structure.

A Zheng-Dao NE-1 was deployed against a fortified position during a corporate conflict, and the 'clean' building was reoccupied within hours — but the rapid reoccupation timeline suggests they knew it was a neutron weapon and had the seizure force ready before the attack.

physical_description.visual_profile: A massive, angular weapon platform resembling a hybrid between industrial particle accelerator and military gun emplacement. The NE-1 presents a brutalist silhouette — a long, ribbed barrel assembly mounted on a heavy tripod base with prominent heat dissipation fins. The overall aesthetic is utilitarian and deliberately intimidating, with no aesthetic ornamentation; every surface serves functional purpose.
physical_description.dimensions: Barrel length: 180 cm; Overall width (mounted): 120 cm; Height to sight rail: 95 cm; Depth with stabilizers: 140 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Extremely heavy and imposing — 85 kg on vehicle mount, requiring anchored installation or dedicated transport. Even from across a room, the weapon conveys massive inertia and immovable authority.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced steel frame with tungsten-lined barrel housing; borated polyethylene shielding panels integral to structure
physical_description.finish: Industrial matte gunmetal gray with scattered scorch marks and thermal discoloration patterns from repeated use. Surfaces show oxidized patches and heat-stress streaking consistent with neutron generation cycles.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant gunmetal gray with burnt sienna heat-stress zones around barrel breach; black borated shielding panels; safety-yellow striping on power conduits and mounting hardware
physical_description.grip_texture: N/A — weapon is crew-operated stationary platform; control surfaces feature textured rubberized panels with integrated emergency cutoff grip (bright red, bare polymer)
distinctive_features: Ribbed cooling fins running the entire barrel length in chevron pattern
Glowing blue-white accelerator chamber visible through reinforced viewport at breach point
Three lead-glass observation ports with radiation-warning trefoil symbols etched at 120° intervals
Massive toroidal coil assembly surrounding the midpoint of barrel — visible as dark metallic ring with faint electromagnetic shimmer
Heavy-duty electrical umbilical bundle (thick thermally-insulated cables) feeding into power distribution collar behind trigger mechanism
Mechanical countdown timer dial mounted on left stabilizer arm — analog readout with radiation-hazard markings in GLMZ standard yellow/black
Worn operational markings: distance tick-marks scored into barrel shroud, faded targeting references, impact dents from field transport
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES stamped in aggressive block letters across the barrel shroud (30 cm from muzzle); serial plate mounted on right stabilizer arm with holographic security foil (heavily scratched); small red inspection seal affixed to power conduit (broken/obsolete); faint factory test stamps visible on barrel bore cover when opened
physical_description.condition_typical: Battle-worn and actively maintained. Surfaces show heavy use and field deployment — thermal stress marks, radiation-induced material brittleness visible as micro-fracture lines in steel, scorch patterns around exhaust vents. Regular maintenance evident in clean, functional components despite weathered exterior. No cosmetic effort; purely operational condition.
